ladder.label: UNCONFIRMED TURN
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup is forming (swing low in, momentum turned up) — but the higher timeframes haven't confirmed it: the bigger picture is still bearish (weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle overdue). This is an UNCONFIRMED TURN, not a confirmed buy. Weekly confirmation lags price, so this exact reading covers BOTH bounces that fail AND the first leg of a genuine new cycle — you can't tell which in real time, so treat it as a risk/size signal, not a direction call. Measured: weekly-unconfirmed bottoming setups held the low ~49% of the time vs ~68% once the weekly turns up.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 866.65. Not an investment buy yet. What would upgrade it: weekly momentum turning up, a reclaim of the investor-cycle low, or the first daily cycle right-translating — add on confirmation, not ahead of it.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle overdue
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle overdue (investor cycle week 31 · daily cycle day 10).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): unconfirmed turn. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)

entry.text: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 866.65. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.

ladder.why_zh: 正在形成日线筑底形态（摆动低点已现、动量转向上行）——但更高周期尚未确认：大局仍偏空（周线动量开始上翘；投资者周期已逾期）。这是「未确认转向」，并非已确认的买入。周线确认滞后于价格，因此同样的读数既涵盖最终失败的反弹，也涵盖真正新周期的第一段——实时无法判定属于哪一种，故应将其视为风险/仓位信号，而非方向判断。实测：周线未确认的筑底形态约 49% 守住低点，周线转向后升至约 68%。
ladder.next_zh: 仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 866.65 下方。暂非投资性买入。何种情形会升级：周线动量转为向上、收复投资者周期低点、或首个日线周期呈右移结构——在确认之后加仓，而非提前。

points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）

ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UNCONFIRMED TURN signal triggered 2 trading days ago (~2026-06-23), switching from BOTTOMING. Signal strength: mild (score -25/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 未确认转向信号于 2 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-23），自筑底中切换而来。 信号强度：温和（评分 -25/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱未确认转向（+18）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✗ · 3日 ✓ · 周线 ✓ · 月线 —
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。

entry_signal.headline_zh: 过度拉伸 — 等待回撤
entry_signal.action: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 866.65. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.
entry_signal.action_zh: 未确认转向：日线低点正在形成，但大局仍偏空。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 866.65 下方。在周线确认前并非投资性买入；多数最终失败，少数则开启新周期。

timing.next_trigger: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 866.65. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.

levels.label_en: 25% over the 200-day (out of the chase zone)
levels.label_zh: 高于200日均线25%（脱离追高区）

pullback_zone.headline_en: Don't chase the print — let it come back. Accumulate on a pullback into the zone below: the leader you want, at a non-chase price.
pullback_zone.headline_zh: 勿追当下价位 — 等它回落。回调进入下方区间时分批建仓：你想要的领涨股，以非追高价位。

headline.en: Rate risk runs through its market / growth beta, not a distinct duration leg.
headline.zh: 其利率风险通过市场／成长beta体现，并无独立的久期暴露。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta -0.42 ± 0.28 — medium precision. Sector anchor (XLI) reads duration-neutral (+0.01). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta -0.42 ± 0.28——精度中。 板块锚（XLI）为久期中性（+0.01）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。

caveat.en: Public-record alt-data convergence — the unusual-activity layer. Graded vs SPY in the Signal Intelligence ledger; weight by that track record, not a standalone trade signal.
caveat.zh: 公开记录替代数据汇聚——异常活动层。在信号情报战绩中对标普评分；据该战绩权衡，而非独立交易信号。

detail.en: Bled-out accumulation with a low composite — the washed-out side where forward returns have historically been better. A contrarian setup, not a trigger.
detail.zh: 吸筹枯竭且综合分偏低 — 超卖一侧，历史上未来回报更佳。逆向机会，并非触发信号。

caveat.en: Contrarian read — the INVERSE of the indicator's usual framing. Validated (display-only) that a high composite flags lower forward-63d returns (decile Spearman −0.88) and that rising 'whale accumulation' precedes under-performance (monthly IC t≈−3.9). Large-cap survivor sample; a tilt, not a trade.
caveat.zh: 逆向解读 — 与该指标常规用法相反。经验证（仅供展示）：高综合分预示未来63日回报更低（分位单调 Spearman −0.88），且“鲸鱼吸筹”上升反而领先跑输（月度 IC t≈−3.9）。样本为大盘幸存股；是倾斜而非交易信号。

decision.headline: Extended — don't chase; wait for a pullback
decision.headline_zh: 过度拉升 — 勿追高；等待回撤
decision.gloss: Ran too far, too fast — don't chase; wait for a dip.
decision.gloss_zh: 涨得太快太远——勿追高；等待回撤。

trust.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

timing.text: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 866.65. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.
timing.text_zh: 未确认转向：日线低点正在形成，但大局仍偏空。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 866.65 下方。在周线确认前并非投资性买入；多数最终失败，少数则开启新周期。

decision.conflict_note: Top board rank, but timing, accounting, fundamentals blocks a buy now — the rank measures the name, not the moment.
decision.conflict_note_zh: 板内排名靠前，但时机、财务质量、基本面阻碍当前买入——排名衡量个股，而非买入时机。

axes.label: earnings · insider · revisions
axes.label_zh: 盈利 · 内部人 · 评级调整

falsifiers.zh: 盘面承压 — 减仓／确认

falsifiers.en: Narrative basket (Data-Center Power & Cooling) is crowded / extended — cap size, don't add aggressively.
falsifiers.zh: 所属叙事篮子（数据中心电力与散热）拥挤／过度拉伸 — 控制仓位，勿激进加仓。

trend.label: Trend
trend.value_zh: 上行 · 较200日均线 +39% · 逆势
trend.gloss: Where price sits vs its 200-day average, and how strong the trend is (ADX).
trend.gloss_zh: 价格相对200日均线的位置，以及趋势强度（ADX）。

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.gloss_zh: 日线／3日／周线三个周期的动量方向。

extension.label: Extension
extension.gloss: Ran too far above trend — high pullback risk.
extension.gloss_zh: 远高于趋势——回撤风险高。

rel_strength.label: Relative strength
rel_strength.gloss_zh: 相对行业的价格强度——参考。

valuation.label: Valuation
valuation.gloss: Cheap/rich vs the market — context, not a buy signal.
valuation.gloss_zh: 相对大盘的估值——参考，非买入信号。

quality.label: Quality
quality.gloss: Accounting flags — verify before trusting the numbers.
quality.gloss_zh: 财务质量警示——核实后再信赖数据。

positioning.label: Positioning
positioning.value_zh: 内部人卖出 · 做空 3% 流通
positioning.gloss: Insider buying (an edge) and short interest (a risk).
positioning.gloss_zh: 内部人买入（优势）与做空比例（风险）。

squeeze.label: Vol squeeze
squeeze.gloss: Compression → a move is loading; direction unconfirmed until it breaks.
squeeze.gloss_zh: 波动压缩——更大行情正在蓄势；突破前方向未定。

volatility.label: Risk & size
volatility.value_zh: 常见回撤 -10% · 极端 -28% · → 建议仓位 0%
volatility.gloss: Expected downside drives how big to size.
volatility.gloss_zh: 预期下行决定建议仓位大小。

ownership.label: Ownership & flow
ownership.value_zh: 1 家 13F 持有人 · 减仓中（2→1 家，6季） · 高度集中
ownership.gloss: Who owns it and how concentrated; multi-quarter 13F holder trend (lagged ~45d) + how many backtest-skilled funds are buying (descriptive context).
ownership.gloss_zh: 谁在持有、集中度如何；多季度 13F 持有人趋势（滞后约45天）以及有多少回测优质基金在买入（仅供参考）。

macro.label: Macro exposure
macro.gloss: Rate / inflation sensitivity — context, never scored.
macro.gloss_zh: 利率／通胀敏感度——参考，不计分。

catalyst.label: Catalyst
catalyst.gloss: Next earnings date and any earnings/revision edge.
catalyst.gloss_zh: 下次财报日期与盈利／评级优势。
